question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who always expects the worst possible outcome
solution:
The correct answer is **"Pessimist."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **"pessimist"** is a person who always expects the worst possible outcome. (निराशावादी व्‍यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example**: *Change may not come as fast, or as brutally, as the **pessimists**__ fear.*
 
 
 
• The word** "pessimist"** is a noun.
 
• The opposite of a **pessimist is an optimist**, who always expects the best possible outcome.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: Optimist** - a person who always expects the best possible outcome. (आशावादी व्यक्ति)
 
• **Option 3: Preacher** - someone who delivers religious sermons or talks. (धर्मोपदेशक)
 
• **Option 4: Serial killer** - a person who has killed multiple people over a period of time. (वह व्यक्ति जिसने समय-समय पर कई लोगों की हत्या की हो)
